decubation.definition: n. Act of lying down; decumbence.

decubital necrosis.translation: [医] 褥疮性坏死, 褥疮

decubital ulcer.translation: [医] 褥疮性溃疡, 褥疮

decubitus.definition: n. a reclining position (as in a bed)
decubitus.translation:
n. 褥疮, 卧位
[医] 卧位, 卧, 褥疮

deculturation.translation: 去文化作用去文化作用

decuman.definition:
a. Large; chief; -- applied to an extraordinary billow,
   supposed by some to be every tenth in order. [R.] Also used
   substantively.
decuman.translation: a. 巨大的,与古罗马军团步兵第十队有关的

decumaria.translation: [网络] 赤壁草属；赤壁木属

decumbency.definition: n. The act or posture of lying down.

decumbent.definition: s lying down; in a position of comfort or rest
decumbent.translation: a. 匍生的, 爬在地上的, 匍匐的

decumbiture.definition:
n. Confinement to a sick bed, or time of taking to one's
   bed from sickness.
n. Aspect of the heavens at the time of taking to one's
   sick bed, by which the prognostics of recovery or death were made.

decuple.definition:
a. Tenfold.
n. A number ten times repeated.
v. t. To make tenfold; to multiply by ten.
decuple.translation:
n. 十倍
a. 十倍的
vt. 十倍于

decupled.translation:
a. 十倍的
n. 十倍
vt. 十倍于

decupling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Decuple
decupling.translation:
a. 十倍的
n. 十倍
vt. 十倍于

decurarization.translation: [医] 除箭毒[作用], 去箭毒[作用]

decurion.definition:
n. A head or chief over ten; especially, an officer who
   commanded a division of ten soldiers.

decurions.definition:
plural of decurion
n. A head or chief over ten; especially, an officer who
   commanded a division of ten soldiers.
decurions.translation: (decurion 的复数) 十人长, 什长

decurler.translation: 卷曲消除器; 卷曲消除器

decurrence.definition: n. The act of running down; a lapse.

decurrent.definition:
a. Extending downward; -- said of a leaf whose base extends
   downward and forms a wing along the stem.
decurrent.translation:
a. 向下生长的
[医] 向下的

decurtate pulse.translation: [医] 缓退脉, 鼠尾状脉

decurved.definition: s. bent down or curved downward

decury.definition: n. A set or squad of ten men under a decurion.
decury.translation: n. 十人团体, 十人小组

decussate.definition:
v. cross or intersect so as to form a cross
s. crossed or intersected in the form of an X
decussate.translation:
v. (使)交叉成X形, (使)交叉
a. 交叉的, 交叉成X形的

decussated.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Decussate
a. Crossed; intersected.
a. Growing in pairs, each of which is at right angles to
   the next pair above or below; as, decussated leaves or branches.
a. Consisting of two rising and two falling clauses,
   placed in alternate opposition to each other; as, a decussated period.
decussated.translation:
a. 交叉的；直角交叉的
vi. 交叉成十字形；交叉成X形

decussates.definition: v. cross or intersect so as to form a cross
decussates.translation:
a. 交叉的；直角交叉的
vi. 交叉成十字形；交叉成X形

decussating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Decussate
decussating.translation:
a. 交叉的；直角交叉的
vi. 交叉成十字形；交叉成X形

decussatio fontinalis.translation: [医] 被盖后交叉(顶盖脊髓束交叉)

decussation.definition: n an intersection or crossing of two tracts in the form of the letter X
decussation.translation: n. X形交叉, 十字交叉
